intro: One playthrough, no difficulty settings, no mission replay and no online trophies: the platinum is a marathon of roughly 200 hours, most of it inside the 100% checklist. Only one trophy can be missed — Positive Mental Attitude, whose first meditation spot exists only in Chapter 1 — so the roadmap front-loads that warning and leaves everything else to free roam, which stays open after the credits. Never use cheats on a trophy run: published guides agree they disable trophies and saving. Make a manual save at the start and end of every chapter.

stages.summary: Play the opening of the story: Gone Fishing and the rest of Chapter 1. One thing in this chapter never comes back — the meditation on the balcony of Jason's house. The morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia is in the kitchen talking about meditating, then walks out to the balcony. Follow her, choose Accept, and finish the meditation. It feeds the counter for Positive Mental Attitude, the list's only missable trophy, and guides have not confirmed the counter can reach 18 without it. Everything else in Chapter 1 can wait for free roam.
tips: Manual save before you finish Chapter 1, so the balcony meditation can be recovered if you rushed past it.
Start scanning every new vehicle you drive and studying animals as you meet them; the habits pay off in stages 4 and 5.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — Start Clean, Miss Nothing

stages.summary: Finish the main story across its five chapters: the chapter trophies, the named-mission trophies (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the gold for the final mission all unlock automatically on the way. Take optional missions as they appear — an optional Chapter 4 mission opens the bank vault jobs needed later — and sample each of the nine activity types once for Master of None. After Coffee Break in Chapter 2 you can travel as both protagonists together, which the last meditation spot requires. When the credits roll, free roam continues and the 100% Completion checklist unlocks.
tips: Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter; missions cannot be replayed.
Quest givers tied to trophies sometimes go quiet mid-story. That is not a lockout: they return, and their strands can be finished after the story.
stages.title: The Story Run — Chapters 2 to 5

stages.summary: Close out the people stories. Finish the final missions for Andy (played as Lucia), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (played as Jason), complete Bret's hunt for the unique animal, and keep going until eight full stranger strands are complete for the silver Strangers & Freaks. A strand means the whole chain for one person, not a single meeting. These strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so this stage is purely for its trophies — and every strand finished here is one less loose end at the end.
tips: If a quest giver has no marker, progress the story or return after the credits; trophy questlines always reopen.
Bret's strand doubles as preparation for the card sets in stage 5 through his Target Deck quests.
stages.title: Strangers, Freaks & Character Questlines

stages.summary: The long gold. Open Progress, then 100% Completion, and work the checklist in free roam: every robbery type, all eight bank vaults (five earn Maximum Withdrawal on the way), one illegal operation robbed from each of the nine gangs for Pest Control, gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges for The Shootist, a Top Fun drone race win at all 14 locations, 250 stunts toward Cunning Stunts (the checklist itself asks for 300), and 70 of the 80 challenges — passing 50 earns One Last Thing on the way. The checklist asks for a healthy share of the game rather than literally everything, so clear its categories in an order that also feeds the other counters.
tips: Route each play session around two or three checklist categories at once so travel time serves several counters.
Bank vaults only open after the optional Chapter 4 mission from stage 2 — if no vault jobs show, that mission is the missing key.
stages.title: The 100% Checklist — A Long Road

stages.summary: Sweep up everything counted in collections and cash. Finish the remaining meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude (18 in all, the last needing both protagonists together), complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets, scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app, reach 100 discovered vehicles, explore all 52 areas of Leonida, win 20 different races, launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 across shops, buy all 8 garage properties, and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Most of these counters should already be well fed by the earlier stages; this stage is where you check the Progress menu and hunt the remainders deliberately.
tips: Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice — bring both to every remaining spot.
For card sets, finish the three sets you are closest to instead of spreading effort across all 18.
stages.title: Collections & the Leonida Sweep

stages.summary: Whatever is left is a list of one-off moments: beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, lose a four-star wanted level with your partner, rob three shops back-to-back under one wanted level, five takedowns in a single Combat Focus, an unscheduled departure from VCIA, a quiet jewelry store robbery, an armored truck robbery, the showroom-glass exit, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the bowling follow-through, both protagonists' strength maxed, the melee drive-by, and the strange-event and second-chance trophies that tend to arrive when you stop forcing them. When the last of the 54 falls, Vice Got a Price! unlocks by itself. You are a Leonida Legend.
tips: Use this tracker's filters: show unearned trophies only and work the list top to bottom.
Keep a manual save before experimenting with the unconfirmed triggers (Challenging Tank, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There) so a failed theory costs nothing.
stages.title: Cleanup & the Platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
